AI Notes.value:
foam Studio is the dedicated commercial arm of Berlin CG collective Zeitguised, founded by Henrik Mauler (Zeitguised co-founder, 2001) and later joined by Curtis Baigent and Matthias Winckelmann (both ex-ManvsMachine London) as co-founders in 2018. Specializes in art-driven 3D CG brand films and product visualization; notable clients include Microsoft, Motorola, Covestro, Nike, Apple, Audi, IBM. Operated as Foam Studio GmbH and Co. KG (Berlin), legal entity terminated July 2020; work may now sit under ZEITGUISED.STUDIO. Sources: northdata.com, stashmedia.tv, Behance (foamstudioberlin), dexigner.com.

Work capture (2026-07-26): live foam.studio 404s and instagram.com/foamstudioberlin/ shows "Profile isn't available", confirming defunct. Captured via Wayback Machine snapshots (2017-2020) of the original case-study pages instead: Microsoft M365, IBM Think Conference, Motorola Moto razr, Covestro Material World, Hennessy X.O and Nike Air Max 95, all CG brand-film/product-viz projects matching the 3D & motion tag. Embedded 4 still-public Vimeo reels (IBM Think, Moto razr launch film, Covestro Material World, Hennessy X.O process reel) with video-still thumbnails, plus 12 stills pulled from archived CDN URLs. A few Covestro stills referenced in the archived HTML were never independently crawled by Wayback (404 on the asset) so were skipped; the embed + thumbnail stand in for that project. Website/Instagram context shots are the "site is gone" screens themselves (Wayback calendar: 124 saves 2017-2025; Instagram's unavailable-profile page), the honest current state.
